rule: Only the exact spans listed here enter the turbo corpus. Each source is a committed repository file pinned by SHA-256, with its rights, a variant identity and the units its span carries. No web page is fetched, no raw third-party document is reproduced, and a document about another part is never turbo evidence. A span that no longer matches its file, or a file under an exclusion, fails the check.

variants.bionic-turbo-f1-pair: Both members of the bionic turbo F1 comparison pair: the shared concept wheel, closures, ports and CFD case generator. Original concept geometry; it does not reproduce a K16.
variants.bionic-turbo-f1-reference: Reference member of the pair: baseline.json, volute radius law 6 + 8t mm, conical F0 chamber.
variants.bionic-turbo-f1-bionic: Bionic member of the pair: candidate.json, area-affine volute law sqrt(36 + 160t) mm, same wheel and chamber.
variants.bionic-turbo-f1-combined-rejected: candidate-combined.json, wheel-profile chamber with the area-affine volute; rejected for the current CFD and kept as evidence.
variants.bionic-turbo-f0-concept-assembly: Bionic turbo F0 39-component concept assembly; every dimension is a display assumption.
variants.borgwarner-k16-5316-988-6735-6736: Stock Porsche 993 Turbo BorgWarner/KKK K16 pair 5316-988-6735 (right) and 5316-988-6736 (left), identified by catalogue cross-reference only. Not the concept turbo.
variants.k16-generic-service-chart: Generic K16 service-reference chart of a turbo specialist; the exact 993 K16-6735/6736 revision is not established.
variants.kkk-5316-988-6717-2467-gga-ggb: KKK 5316 988 6717 with the 2467 GGA/GGB compressor, an Audi 1.8T upgrade application. Identity with the 993 units is not established.
variants.bwts-k16-2467g-996-m96-70: BWTS K16-2467G of the Porsche 996 Turbo M96/70 as catalogued by a test-bench provider; dataset not acquired.
variants.fvd-k16-24-hybrid: FVD K16/24 aftermarket hybrid; exact donor core not identified.
variants.generic-method-reference: Method or convention reference; describes no particular turbocharger.
variants.993-turbo-m64-60-engine: Stock Porsche 993 Turbo M64/60 engine context and illustrative engine-flow points; not a turbocharger measurement.
variants.synthetic-control: Authored adversarial fixture; not evidence about any turbocharger.
